solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: The last but one round house

definitions.meaning: the ...-final is the round before the final of a competition
a ...-detached house, one of a joined pair

explanation.walkthrough: A 'semi' in Britain is a house sharing one wall with its neighbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for both a semi-final and a semi-detached house, two common British abbreviations.

clue.text: They make cuts, worrying us with a secret

indicators.note: worrying suggests the letters are troubled and shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone frets that a hidden matter cuts close to home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worrying' shuffles US and A SECRET together.
explanation.definitionFit: Garden pruning shears, a tool whose whole job is snipping stems.

clue.text: Books labour of sorts on Sunday

parts.note: manual labour is one kind of work

explanation.surface: Reading up on some kind of work done at the weekend.
explanation.definitionFit: Handbooks of instructions are books by another name.

clue.text: Understand it to be a figure

parts.note: to dig something is slang for understanding or liking it

explanation.surface: Grasping that something counts as a number.
explanation.definitionFit: A single numeral from nought to nine is a figure.

clue.text: Daughter teaching misses a logical inference

indicators.note: misses means the following letter is left out of the word before

parts.note: teaching is education

explanation.surface: A girl skips lessons, a conclusion someone might reasonably reach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misses' drops A from EDUCATION, leaving EDUCTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Reasoning from premises to a conclusion is what a deduction is.

clue.text: One's chasing one's inheritance for a start

indicators.note: chasing means this piece runs after the other, so it comes second

parts.note: genes are what we inherit from parents
one is, written I'S, gives I and S

explanation.surface: An heir pursues their legacy from the very beginning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's' is read as 'one is', contracted; 'chasing' places it second, and 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The origin or beginning of something, as in the first book of the Bible.

clue.text: Character from overseas in the volunteers

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: A foreigner serving among volunteer soldiers.
explanation.walkthrough: The TA is the British Army's part-time volunteer reserve. 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A letter of the Greek alphabet is a character from a foreign script.

clue.text: Cast female lead in drama

parts.note: she is the female pronoun

indicators.note: lead in means the opening letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: Choosing the leading lady for a play.
explanation.definitionFit: To shed is to cast off, as a snake casts its skin.

clue.text: More certain about right conclusion, but give in

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes round the others

parts.note: surer means more certain
the end is the conclusion

explanation.surface: Being surer of the right outcome yet yielding anyway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals the wrap-round; 'but' is a link joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To yield or capitulate is to give up the fight.

clue.text: Hold fast? He can in trouble!

indicators.note: trouble suggests the letters are stirred up and disordered

explanation.surface: A man in difficulties offers to restrain something.
explanation.definitionFit: To bind in fetters is to hold someone fast.

clue.text: Kind of eccentric in trouble from sting

indicators.note: in trouble suggests the letters are in disarray and need sorting

explanation.surface: An odd character gets into bother after a police trap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kind of' looks like a filler but is part of the fodder; all fifteen letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A sting is slang for a swindle in which a con artist wins the victim's trust.

clue.text: Ruling on leader of Tory tabloid is disastrous

indicators.note: on means this piece is placed after the earlier ones
leader of means the first letter of the word that follows

parts.note: a rag is a disparaging word for a downmarket newspaper
IC is in charge, so ruling

explanation.surface: A judgment on the head of a Conservative newspaper proves catastrophic.
explanation.walkthrough: In crosswords 'ruling' can mean in charge; 'on' places it after the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Tragic events are calamitous ones, like a tragedy on stage.

clue.text: Second group of lawyers accept speed is key

parts.note: pace is speed
the Bar is the body of barristers

explanation.surface: Another legal body agrees that haste is essential.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the Bar is the collective name for barristers; 'accept' signals the insertion, and 'is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The long bar at the bottom of a keyboard is one of its keys.

clue.text: Winning looks for the audience on the floor above

parts.note: up means ahead or winning, as in two goals up

indicators.note: for the audience means as heard by listeners, a homophone

parts.note: stares are long looks

explanation.surface: A performer ahead in the game gazes out at the crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on a higher storey of a house is being upstairs.

clue.text: Hurried in the back way, before silent change

indicators.note: in means the word for hurried goes inside
back means the letters of way's abbreviation are turned round

parts.note: ST is street, a way
ran means hurried
mute means silent

explanation.surface: Someone rushed through the rear entrance before a quiet transformation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the street abbreviation round and 'in' signals the insertion; 'before' simply orders the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To transmute is to change form or substance, as alchemists hoped to turn lead to gold.

clue.text: Blushing worker gets a six-footer

parts.note: blushing means red-faced
a worker is an ant in crosswords, after the worker ant

explanation.surface: An embarrassed employee meets a very tall person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'six-footer' suggests a tall person but means an insect with six legs.
explanation.definitionFit: Insects have six legs, so a type of ant is jokily a six-footer.

clue.text: Make alterations behind the kitchen stove

parts.note: rear means behind
a range is a large cooking stove

explanation.surface: Redesigning the space behind the cooker.
explanation.definitionFit: To reorganise or put in a new order is to make changes.

clue.text: Pinch a foot here inside, and be like your mother

parts.note: to pinch is to take or steal

indicators.note: inside means the middle letters of the word here

explanation.surface: Someone steals a step in this place and turns out like their parent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' takes the inner letters of HERE, giving ER. 'and' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To resemble a parent in looks or character is to take after them.

clue.text: Injury caused by rabies originally in part of Europe

indicators.note: in means the initial letter goes inside the country

parts.note: Spain is a country in Europe

indicators.note: originally means the first letter of the word before

explanation.surface: A disease outbreak in a European country causes harm.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrenched joint or ligament is a common injury.

clue.text: Replace damaged fabric

indicators.note: damaged means the letters are broken and put back differently

explanation.surface: A request to swap out torn cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: A closely woven cotton used for sheets is a fabric.

clue.text: Trauma surrounding rampant ram in clover

indicators.note: surrounding means the shock goes round the jumbled animal

parts.note: shock is a trauma

indicators.note: rampant means unrestrained and wild, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A wild sheep causes distress in a field of clover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rampant' signals the jumble of the animal and 'surrounding' the wrap-round; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The three-leaved plant, emblem of Ireland, is a kind of clover.

clue.text: Frame for jewellery — going down!

definitions.meaning: the metal mount holding a gem in a ring
what the sun is doing at dusk as it sinks

explanation.definitionFit: Both the mount of a stone and the sun sinking below the horizon.

clue.text: Former working nurse finally gets prison sentence

parts.note: on means working, as a machine is on

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of the word before

parts.note: doing time is serving a prison sentence

explanation.surface: An ex-employee nurse is eventually jailed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something one-time was so formerly, as in a one-time champion.

clue.text: Search for gold exposed by Panorama

definitions.meaning: to look for gold or other minerals in the ground

explanation.walkthrough: 'exposed by' is a link between the two definitions; Panorama is also a BBC current affairs programme, adding to the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Both the verb for mining exploration and a noun for a sweeping view.

clue.text: Render a service, keeping score

indicators.note: keeping means the phrase holds the answer within its letters

explanation.surface: A tennis player serves while the umpire keeps the tally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'score' looks like the points tally, but means to score out.
explanation.definitionFit: To score out a word is to strike it through, deleting it.

clue.text: Girl who made a return in a new order

indicators.note: return says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A girl comes back to a reorganised world.
explanation.walkthrough: Rowena, a Saxon heroine of Scott's Ivanhoe, is a girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A female given name, here the girl who returns.

clue.text: One hundred per cent humidity — it's the limit!

definitions.meaning: air holding all the moisture it can
the point beyond which nothing more can be absorbed

explanation.definitionFit: The stage at which air or a solution can hold no more water vapour or solute.

clue.text: Give up church and start doubling earnings

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: start means the first letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: The church begins to double its income.
explanation.definitionFit: To yield or surrender something is to cede it.

clue.text: Bird that bit the head off a dog?

indicators.note: bit the head off means the first letter is removed

parts.note: a beagle is a breed of hound

explanation.surface: A bird of prey decapitates a hound.
explanation.definitionFit: A large bird of prey, such as the golden one.

clue.text: Support pub with investment of energy

indicators.note: investment means putting inside, so energy goes into the pub

parts.note: a bar is a pub
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Backing a pub with an injection of vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear a load is to support it.
